summary: Added W (solution-size) capture to scripts/bench-arm.js. New step (e) runs BEFORE the result emit (worktree still exists): diffChars = chars of `git -C <wt> --no-pager diff HEAD` + byte sizes of all untracked files (git ls-files --others --exclude-standard). diffTokens = round(diffChars/4). Both bounded (maxBuffer) and wrapped in try/catch (default 0). Added to JSON result line; all existing fields intact. node --check passes; verified on synthetic worktree.
